sentences.ko: 아, 너 이번 이별 다 털어내면 우리 쇼핑 가자.
sentences.text: Oh, when you get over this breakup, we need to go shopping.

alts.text: Once you're over this breakup, we're so going shopping.
After you have recovered from this breakup, we should go shopping together.

sentences.note: **get over**는 이별·병·실망 같은 일에서 마음을 추스르고 회복한다는 뜻입니다. 친구를 위로하면서 '다 털어내면 ~하자'고 할 때 그대로 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 너희 그 카페에 너무 붙어 산다.
sentences.text: You guys hang out at the coffee house way too much.

alts.text: Seriously, you're always at that coffee house.
All of you spend far too much time at the coffee house.

sentences.note: **hang out**은 특별한 일 없이 어울려 시간을 보내는 것입니다. **way too much**는 '너무 지나치게'를 세게 말할 때 쓰는데, 친구를 놀릴 때 잘 어울립니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 야, 걔가 너보다 빨리 뛴다고? 말도 안 돼.
sentences.text: I can't believe she can outrun you, man.

alts.text: No way she's faster than you, dude.
It is hard to believe that she is able to run faster than you.

sentences.note: **outrun**은 '달리기로 앞지르다'를 한 낱말로 말하는 표현입니다. **I can't believe**로 시작하면 놀라거나 친구를 놀리는 말투가 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아니면 그냥 남자를 아예 멀리해야 하나.
sentences.text: Or maybe I should stay away from all men.

alts.text: Maybe I'm just done with guys altogether.
Perhaps I ought to avoid men entirely.

sentences.note: **stay away from**은 일부러 거리를 두고 피한다는 뜻입니다. **Or maybe I should**는 혼잣말로 '아니면 ~해야 하나' 하고 고민할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 으깬 감자 덩어리 좀 남게 해 줄 수 있어?
sentences.text: Will you make the mashed potatoes with the lumps?

alts.text: Can you do the lumpy mashed potatoes?
Would you please prepare the mashed potatoes with the lumps left in?

sentences.note: **Will you make ...?**는 가까운 사람에게 음식을 해 달라고 부탁할 때 씁니다. **with the lumps**처럼 with를 붙이면 '~가 들어간 식으로'라는 취향을 짧게 말할 수 있습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 철자가 어떻게 되세요? 틀리지 않게 적으려고요.
sentences.text: How do you spell that so we can get it right?

alts.text: Can you spell that for me? Wanna get it right.
Could you please spell that for us so that we can make sure it is correct?

sentences.note: 이름이나 주소를 받아 적을 때 **How do you spell that** 으로 철자를 물어요. **get it right** 는 '틀리지 않게 제대로 하다'라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내 말은, 그 사람들은 그런 거 말고도 신경 쓸 게 많다는 거지.
sentences.text: I mean, they have more important things to worry about.

alts.text: They've got bigger things to worry about.
What I mean is that they have far more important matters to be concerned about.

sentences.note: **more important things to worry about** 는 '그런 데 신경 쓸 겨를이 없다'는 말이에요. 앞에 붙은 **I mean** 은 '내 말은' 하고 방금 한 말을 풀어 설명할 때 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 둘이 같이 있는 시간이 더 길었으면 좋았을 텐데, 아쉽다.
sentences.text: It's a shame you two didn't get to spend more time together.

alts.text: Too bad you two didn't get more time together.
What a pity that the two of you were not able to spend more time together.

sentences.note: **It's a shame** 는 '창피하다'가 아니라 '아쉽다'예요. **get to** 는 '~할 기회가 있다'라는 뜻이라 didn't get to 는 '~할 기회가 없었다'가 돼요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 응, 근데 걔 비행기가 아테네에서 연착됐대.
sentences.text: Yeah, but her plane got delayed in Athens.

alts.text: Her flight's stuck in Athens, though.
That is true; however, her flight was delayed in Athens.

sentences.note: 비행기나 기차가 늦어졌을 때 **got delayed** 라고 해요. **Yeah, but** 은 상대 말을 일단 인정하고 나서 반대 사정을 꺼낼 때 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 내가 재킷을 두고 와서 다시 돌아가야 했어.
sentences.text: We had to go back cuz I forgot my jacket.

alts.text: Left my jacket, so we went back for it.
Because I had forgotten my jacket, we were obliged to return.

sentences.note: **had to go back** 은 '어쩔 수 없이 다시 갔다'는 말이에요. **cuz** 는 because 를 말할 때 줄여 부른 것이라 친구끼리 대화에서 자주 들려요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends
